items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: Luis Conte came to the United States in 1967 and has become an in-demand session musician as well as a touring artist with James Taylor

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. That makes sense. And also it may depend somewhat on the form of the song. Is there any times where you just feel like my contribution here is to not play?

Oh yeah. Lay out or play something – you know you have a percussion set so go to another color. You know and I hear, maybe because I played guitar and I hear the chords. I don't know exactly where the chords are if I don’t have a chart or anything like that, but I hear the changes. I’m aware of all that when I’m playing. It’s very important to know that you know because it’s music. You know you’re beating on things but you’re playing music. James Taylor says, “Man, Luis Conte, he thinks and makes music. Well you…
You’re serving the song. You have to serve the song, correct?
